annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it instructs viewers to pay BUSD and approve a Forsage registration, then promotes making money through referral recruitment and an upline/team structure. It explicitly says the account's results are empty because nobody has been referred and encourages viewers to join the team and share their referral link to make money. The earning promise is therefore tied to recruiting participants into a multi-level matrix rather than an ordinary wallet or registration tutorial.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the video presents an upline, activated levels, referral-dependent results, and team-based earning claims. The video also guides viewers through the required BUSD registration and contract-approval steps before encouraging them to recruit others.
